name: Crowd Murmur
description: Take in the murmur of a whole room of spirits and sort the loudest from the rest.

name: Unease Spot
description: Spot the one spirit in a crowd that hides unease behind a calm face.

name: Sealed Spirit
description: Hold the user's spirit apart from the crowd so that its feeling does not leak in.

name: Calm Ripple
description: Send a ripple of calm through a frightened group and watch the panic settle.

name: Intent Pick
description: Pick out the single hostile intent among many friendly ones in a crowded hall.

name: Resolve Wave
description: Pulse a shared sense of resolve through allies so that they stand as one.

name: Throng Reading
description: Read all the spirits of a field at once and rank them by threat and fear.

name: Panic Break
description: Break the nerve of a gathered foe with a sudden shared wave of dread.

name: Awareness Edge
description: Find the edge of another's awareness and learn what lies just outside it.

name: Thought Cloak
description: Cloak the user's thought in a plain surface so that a probing sense passes over it.

name: Mind Trace
description: Trace the path of a spirit's attention as it moves across a crowded room.

name: Lull Brush
description: Brush a restless spirit with a lull that eases it toward sleep.

name: Edge Walking
description: Walk along the edge of a foe's awareness so that the user is never quite noticed.

name: Attention Pull
description: Pull a foe's attention to the wrong place at the moment it matters.

name: Pressure Tide
description: Let a tide of felt pressure roll onto a foe until their mind sags.

name: Lasting Mark
description: Leave a mark on a foe's awareness that colours every later thought they have.

name: Awareness Tether
description: Tether the user's attention to a foe's so that every turn of their mind is felt.

name: Dual Presence
description: Hold two presences at once and let the nearer one take the notice of the room.

name: Seen Self
description: Show the room one calm self while the other self listens in the dark.

name: Listening Twin
description: Send the second presence round the edge of a gathering to gather its mood.

name: Paired Comfort
description: Comfort an ally with both presences at once so that the shaken spirit is held twice.

name: Swap Notice
description: Swap which presence a foe notices at the moment of a feint.

name: Shared Spirit
description: Share the second presence with an ally so that both fight with a steadier mind.

name: Twin Presence Sweep
description: Sweep both presences across the foe's front at once so that their guard loses its centre.

name: Mirror Presence
description: Show a hostile spirit its own face and turn its menace back upon it.

name: Azure Impression
description: Cast a high clear impression of safety over a foe so that their guard drops.

name: Hawk Gaze
description: Fix a keen far gaze on a distant spirit and read its mood from afar.

name: Soaring Calm
description: Rise above the contest in mind and let a wide calm settle on allies below.

name: Light Cover
description: Hold a bright clear feeling about the self that dulls hostile intent.

name: Falling Hush
description: Drop a falling hush onto a distant foe so that their will sinks.

name: Far Trace
description: Trace a spirit across a great distance by the feeling it leaves in the air.

name: Pinion Press
description: Press an impression down on the foe like a wing and let it cloud their sight of friends.

name: Heavenly Weight
description: Bring a heavy feeling of unseen judgment down from above on a gathered foe.

name: Clear Sky Gift
description: Open a clear sky of feeling over allies that lifts their hearts and soothes their spirits.

name: Windborne Murmur
description: Listen for the spirits carried on the wind and note which ones draw near.

name: Draught Curtain
description: Let a gust of the user's own feeling carry hostile intent aside.

name: Vowed Silence
description: Swear to answer only what is meant and keep the rest of the spirit still.

name: Breeze Calming
description: Cool a feverish spirit with a slow breeze of steady feeling.

name: Meant Word
description: Hear whether a spoken word is meant by the spirit that carries it.

name: Scatter Dread
description: Scatter a rising dread among foes on the wind so that none can aim.

name: Truthful Gust
description: Blow a gust through a foe's spirit that makes every lie feel false to them.

name: Vowed Hearing
description: Hold the oath to listen and let no hostile spirit near the user unheard.

name: First Impression
description: Make a quiet first impression on a foe that colours how they read the next blow.

name: Keel Take
description: Take a firm bearing of spirit and keep it against any shifting mood.

name: Mark Sense
description: Feel whether the impression made still lies in the foe's spirit.

name: Hold Gently
description: Hold a hurting ally's spirit gently until the worst of the pain passes.

name: Pressed Doubt
description: Press a doubt into the foe and hold it there as long as the bearing stands.

name: Impression Lend
description: Lend an ally the user's bearing so that their spirit holds the same line.

name: Unmoved Mark
description: Hold the mark upon a foe's spirit so that they cannot shake the feeling.

name: Settled Verdict
description: Settle a felt verdict on the foe that weighs on every move they make.

name: Bearing Share
description: Share the held bearing with a company so that all stand with the same unshaken feeling.
